# Datasets met primaire milieuvariabelen van de hoofdmeetnetten

```{r}
watina <- connect_watina()
```

## Samenstellen van de datasets

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
locs_terr <- 
  get_locs(watina, 
           filterdepth_range = c(0, 3),
           filterdepth_guess = TRUE,
           mask = hmt_pol_buff, 
           join_mask = TRUE,
           buffer = 0, 
           loc_type = "P", 
           loc_validity = c("VLD", "ENT"), 
           collect = TRUE) %>% 
  inner_join(hmt_occ %>% 
               select(polygon_id, type) %>% 
               filter(type != "8310"), 
             # note however that no locations are available for 8310
             by = "polygon_id") %>% 
  select(-polygon_id) %>% 
  mutate(target = "terrestrial") %>% 
  bind_rows(
    # this one appears to yield 0 locations:
    get_locs(watina, 
             filterdepth_range = c(0, 3),
             filterdepth_guess = TRUE,
             mask = habspring_buff %>% 
                    filter(system_type %in% c("mire", "unknown")) %>% 
                    select(type),
             join_mask = TRUE,
             buffer = 0, 
             loc_type = "P", 
             loc_validity = c("VLD", "ENT"), 
             collect = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(target = "terrestrial")
  )
```

```{r paged.print=FALSE}
locs_aq <- 
  get_locs(watina, 
           filterdepth_range = c(0, 7),
           filterdepth_guess = TRUE,
           mask = wsh_pol_ring, 
           join_mask = TRUE,
           buffer = 0, 
           loc_type = "P", 
           loc_validity = c("VLD", "ENT"), 
           collect = TRUE) %>% 
  inner_join(wsh_occ %>% select(polygon_id, type),
             by = "polygon_id") %>% 
  select(-polygon_id) %>% 
  mutate(target = "aquatic") %>% 
  bind_rows(
    get_locs(watina, 
             filterdepth_range = c(0, 7),
             filterdepth_guess = TRUE,
             mask = habstream_buff %>% select(type), 
             join_mask = TRUE,
             buffer = 0, 
             loc_type = "P", 
             loc_validity = c("VLD", "ENT"), 
             collect = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(target = "aquatic")
  ) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    # this one appears to yield 0 locations:
    get_locs(watina, 
             filterdepth_range = c(0, 7),
             filterdepth_guess = TRUE,
             mask = habspring_buff %>% 
                    filter(system_type %in% c("rivulet", "unknown")) %>% 
                    select(type),
             join_mask = TRUE,
             buffer = 0, 
             loc_type = "P", 
             loc_validity = c("VLD", "ENT"), 
             collect = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(target = "aquatic")
  )
```

```{r}
locs_ext <- 
  bind_rows(locs_terr, locs_aq)
locs <- locs_ext %>% 
  distinct(loc_code)
```

```{r}
locs %>% 
  get_xg3(startyear = )
```
